title: Water cooler & Water Purifier
summary: The project aims to install a water cooler at Parel ST Bus Depot to provide safe, clean, and easily accessible drinking water to passengers, bus drivers, conductors, and depot staff.
description: The project aims to install a water cooler at Parel ST Bus Depot to provide safe, clean, and easily accessible drinking water to passengers, bus drivers, conductors, and depot staff. The purpose of the project is to improve access to hygienic drinking water, especially for passengers and staff during hot weather. The project plan includes installing the water cooler at a convenient location, ensuring regular cleaning and maintenance, and keeping it operational throughout the year. The project is expected to benefit approximately 500–1,000 people daily, including passengers and depot personnel.
location: Parel, ST Bus Depot, Mumbai, Maharashtra
